messages:
sana: Quick alert 1
quarterly access review starting now. We found a handful of admin bindings and unlabeled KMS keys. Posting a small quarantine/playbook proposal. Please ack and volunteer owners for anything you touch.

omar: ack. what's the quarantine timeline? we should align with legal/retention.

sana: proposal: 5d grace for self-attest, 21d quarantine (console/API disabled, tag=quarantine:pending), then 90d archive snapshot for retention/legal before final delete. If owner objects, they can request extension via the self-attest form.

lee: sounds reasonable. for KMS keys specifically: prefer rotate+rekey over delete. If asymmetric or customer-managed, we mark `kms:needs-rotation` and open a vuln ticket. For symmetric keys with no use, we schedule disable then schedule destruction in 90d post-archive.

ak: +1. also: enforce RBAC cleanup via IaC where possible. plan: add TFRegistry module with `resource_admin_owners` map, and run a diff to catch drift. quick terraform snippet: 

 ```
 module "entitlement_owner_map" {
   source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal/terraform/modules/owner-map.git"
   owners = var.critical_resources_owners
 }
 ```

ak: then gate PRs that add `roles/owner` or `roles/editor` with a CODEOWNERS check. reduces manual miss.

omar: do we have a concrete command set for listing KMS policies and ownerless principals across clouds? pls paste so SRE can run nightly scan.

lee: i ran a quick multi-cloud script earlier tonight. sample commands i used: 

 ```
 # GCP: list key IAM bindings
 gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=$KR --format="value(name)" | xargs -n1 -I{} gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy {} --keyring=$KR --location=global --format=json

 # AWS: list key metadata and key policy
 aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-policy --key-id {} --profile prod

 # Azure: keyvault key list
 az keyvault key list --vault-name $VAULT --query '[].{name:name}' -o tsv
 ```

lee: also pushed a small scanner: gs://redwood-security/attest/2965432101-kms-scan.csv (6 keys, 3 unowned)

attest-bot: attestation:scan_started ts=2965432101 scope=org module=kms_rbac duration=00:00:00

sana: assigned owners in the sheet:
- key-analytics -> @lee
- admin-cli-svcacct -> @omar
- project-payments-owner-binding -> @ak

ak: created PR #842 in infra-owners to add the new owner map entries and a pre-commit hook to detect ownerless resources. please review.

retention-bot: retention-check: resource_snapshot_required=yes retention_days_min=365 note="Retention team will request archive copy before destructive actions"

omar: legal/retention confirmed via DM. we must keep archived copies for 1yr. note: any archival requiring cross-account transfer needs approval; @sana can coordinate.

lee: i put remediation steps in the runbook: disable console/API, rotate key if used by active services (see `service-bindings.csv`), otherwise schedule destroy after archive window. also added terraform examples for disabling KMS resources.

sana: couple follow-ups: (1) @ak add CODEOWNERS gating to the PR checks (2) @lee attach proof-of-rotation playbook for keys we rotate (3) i'll send attestation emails + self-attest form link and start 5d timer.

attest-bot: attestation:run_complete ts=2965432444 status=partial_orphans=9 report=gs://redwood-security/attest/2965432101-report.json

sana: thanks team. we'll reconvene in 10 days if any items still in quarantine. I'll also file a short postmortem template if we see recurring ownerless patterns. :spiral_calendar:
